```{r}
#| label: setup
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
source(file.path("..", "Figure_Data", "FigureABM.R"))

PROB_VALUES <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

# Sequential blue ramp, steps 100 to 700 (dataviz reference palette)
BLUES <- c(
  "#cde2fb", "#9ec5f4", "#6da7ec", "#3987e5", "#256abf", "#184f95", "#0d366b"
)

fmt <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%d%%", round(100 * x))
```

```{r}
#| label: data
grid <- CJ(rash = PROB_VALUES, ct = PROB_VALUES)

sizes <- grid[,
  {
    d <- as.data.table(readRDS(scenario_file(".", 9, rash, ct))$outbreak_size)
    final <- as.numeric(d[date == max(date)]$outbreak_size)
    final <- final[final >= MIN_OUTBREAK_SIZE]
    list(
      retained = length(final),
      median   = median(final),
      q25      = quantile(final, 0.25, names = FALSE),
      q75      = quantile(final, 0.75, names = FALSE)
    )
  },
  by = .(rash, ct)
]
```

The rash contact reduction (the share of contacts avoided after rash onset) and the contact-tracing success rate on a grid from 0 to 1 at R0 = 9 (`make sensitivity_rash_redux`), with a 21-day quarantine and 90% quarantine willingness; the run without quarantine is not used, since contact tracing only acts through quarantine. Each combination has 1,000 runs; runs with fewer than `r MIN_OUTBREAK_SIZE` cases are excluded as early extinctions. The main analysis uses 0.50 / 0 (self-isolation only) and 0.75 / 0.25 (self-isolation with quarantine). Between `r fmt(min(sizes$retained))` and `r fmt(max(sizes$retained))` runs are retained per combination.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rash-redux
sizes[, cell := sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fmt(median), fmt(q25), fmt(q75))]
tab <- dcast(sizes, rash ~ ct, value.var = "cell")

kable(
  tab[, rash := pct(rash)],
  col.names = c(
    "Rash contact reduction",
    paste("Contact tracing", pct(PROB_VALUES))
  ),
  align     = "lrrrrr",
  caption   = paste(
    "Final outbreak size at day 365, median (interquartile range) across",
    "the retained runs, by rash contact reduction (rows) and contact-tracing",
    "success (columns)."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rash-redux
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Median final outbreak size at day 365 across the retained runs, by rash contact reduction and contact-tracing success."
ggplot(sizes, aes(factor(rash), factor(ct), fill = median)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = fmt(median),
      color = median > mean(range(median))
    ),
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = BLUES,
    labels = fmt,
    name   = "Median infections"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = INK_PRIMARY, "TRUE" = "white")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) pct(as.numeric(x))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) pct(as.numeric(x))) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Rash contact reduction", y = "Contact-tracing success") +
  theme_figure4() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    legend.title       = element_text(color = INK_SECONDARY),
    legend.key.width   = unit(1.6, "cm")
  )
```
